'''Vaor Khazlan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[Raider's Cove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], he helped train fellow bounty hunters who were willing learn from the veteran hunter.<ref name="TOR" />
